## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r}
df1 <- read_csv("../data/recist_deseq2_results.csv")
df2 <- read_csv("../data/irAE_deseq2_results.csv")

```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r}

df1_res <- df1 %>% mutate(df1_micresp = ifelse(padj <= 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0, name, NA)) %>% select(df1_micresp) %>% drop_na(df1_micresp)
                  
df1_nores <- df1 %>% mutate(df1_micnoresp = ifelse(padj <= 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0, name, NA)) %>% select(df1_micnoresp) %>% drop_na(df1_micnoresp)

df2_irae <- df2 %>% mutate(df2_micirae = ifelse(padj <= 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0, name, NA)) %>% select(df2_micirae) %>% drop_na(df2_micirae) 

df2_noirae <- df2 %>% mutate(df2_micnoirae = ifelse(padj <= 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0, name, NA)) %>% select(df2_micnoirae) %>% drop_na(df2_micnoirae)




x = list(A = df1_res$df1_micresp, 
               B = df1_nores$df1_micnoresp, 
               C = df2_irae$df2_micirae, 
               D = df2_noirae$df2_micnoirae)


responders <- list(df1_res)

nonresponders <- list(df1_nores)

irae <- list(df2_irae)

noirae <- list(df2_noirae)

#upset(fromList(x), order.by = "freq")

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
